question: Should every Android `ClawSegmentedControl` with more than four options wrap into balanced rows, or should Skill Workshop own a local multi-row presentation?
rationale: Both approaches solve the demonstrated truncation, but source-level correctness cannot determine the intended app-wide design-system contract or acceptable variable-height behavior for every caller.

options.title: Adopt shared wrapping
options.body: Make balanced wrapping above four options the canonical Android segmented-control behavior after confirming existing callers tolerate variable height.

options.title: Scope to Skill Workshop
options.body: Preserve the shared control’s single-row contract and compose two local rows for the five Skill Workshop filters.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared wrapping
recommendation.body: Make balanced wrapping above four options the canonical Android segmented-control behavior after confirming existing callers tolerate variable height.

likelyOwner.reason: The Android ownership documentation and this PR’s review timeline identify @obviyus as the best available owner for the shared-component decision.
